evidence_class: validated project summary; raw per-run output bundle not yet imported
required_caveats: The match covers frozen features, task orders, exemplar-memory capacity, and DER++ coefficients; it does not establish equal total adaptive-state bytes because Akili stores adapters and semantic prototypes.

The eight-prototype semantic-only diagnostic reached 62.55%, essentially matching Akili routed at 62.52%; therefore the current automatic win is primarily attributable to stable write-once semantic memory, not yet to unique expert-routing gains.
The expert bank remains scientifically relevant because it preserves 79.38% +/- 0.87 oracle capability with zero oracle forgetting, leaving a 16.86-point automatic-access gap.
This is not a state-of-the-art claim and still needs independent Mammoth replication.

supported_claim: Under the matched frozen-feature protocol—same ResNet-50 features, task orders, 400-example memory capacity, and DER++ alpha=beta=0.5—Akili reached 62.52% +/- 0.19 final Class-IL accuracy with 10.34% forgetting, compared with 22.16% +/- 3.09 and 71.70% forgetting for the implemented DER++-400 linear baseline.
